test.name: Muda Tema Para Escuro Via ADB

kw.name: Setup Test Environment
Open Application
kw.doc: Opens a new application to given Appium server. Capabilities of appium server, Android and iOS, Please check https://appium.io/docs/en/2.1/cli/args/ | *Option* | *Man.* | *Description* | | remote_url | Yes | Appium server url | | alias | no | alias | | strict_ssl | No | allows you to send commands to an invalid certificate host like a self-signed one. |

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.
Configura ambiente de teste inicial

kw.name: Get Current Theme
kw.msg: Comando ADB executado: adb -s a83af8e7 shell settings get secure ui_night_mode
kw.doc: Retorna o tema atual do sistema

kw.name: Log
kw.doc: Logs the given message with the given level.

kw.name: Change To Dark Theme
kw.msg: Iniciando mudança para tema escuro via ADB
Comando ADB executado: adb -s a83af8e7 shell settings get secure ui_night_mode
Comando ADB executado: adb -s a83af8e7 shell cmd uimode night yes
Comando ADB executado: adb -s a83af8e7 shell settings get secure ui_night_mode
kw.doc: Muda para tema escuro usando ADB

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Verify Theme Change
Get Current Theme
kw.msg: Comando ADB executado: adb -s a83af8e7 shell settings get secure ui_night_mode
kw.doc: Retorna o tema atual do sistema

kw.name: Should Be Equal As Strings
kw.doc: Fails if objects are unequal after converting them to strings.

kw.name: Log
kw.doc: Logs the given message with the given level.
Verifica se o tema foi alterado corretamente

kw.name: Capture Page Screenshot
kw.doc: Takes a screenshot of the current page and embeds it into the log.

kw.name: Teardown Test Environment
Close Application
kw.doc: Closes the current application and also close webdriver session.
Limpa ambiente após teste
